description: For importing a real part into CAD, 3D printing it, or modelling a mating bracket or enclosure around it. List the direct download URLs of one object's free STEP and STL files (and DXF where a 2D profile exists), with the license to credit. Use it when files are wanted rather than dimensions (get_geometry) or file contents (get_file_content). Objects whose files are a sold Xem design pack return no free files but a note with the x402 and card prices; an object with no files at all returns an empty list and points to its public sources. Neither is an error. URLs are plain HTTPS downloads that need no auth and can be fetched directly; free files are CC BY 4.0 or the Xem Studio Design License as stated in license. Read-only, no charge.

filter.description: Keep only files whose name or note contains this text, e.g. 'm3x10' or '2in'.

object.description: Object slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact object name or alias also resolves; anything else is an error with a hint to search first.

name: get_free_files

dimensions.description: Sizes are exact nominal, no tolerance.

files.description: Free files, one per part or size.

name.description: File name; pass it to get_file_content.

note.description: What the file is, e.g. one size of a family.

size_mb.description: Approximate size in MB when known.

stl.description: Direct STL download URL, or null when only STEP exists.

index.description: URL of the object's machine-readable file index.

license.description: License of the files and who to credit.

mating.description: Mating features, so a part can be prepared without a second call.

exact.description: Its exact size, in mm, with no clearance.

files.description: Which of the object's files carry this feature ('all' or a file name).

fit.description: Fit class: press | slide | run | socket | clamp | designed.

mates.description: What it meets: another object, a standard part, or a fastener size.

note.description: Why the list is empty, or where paid files are sold.

title: List one object's free download links
